newsitem.title: PERU: Peru mediators enter Japanese residence.
newsitem.headline: Peru mediators enter Japanese residence.

text.p: Two mediators in Peru's 82-day hostage crisis entered the Japanese ambassador's residence on Sunday in what appeared to be a resumption of indirect contact between the government and Marxist rebels.
Archbishop Juan Luis Cipriani and Canadian ambassador Anthony Vincent, both members of a three-man mediation commission, walked into the mansion with Cipriani carrying a small suitcase.
The two men walked past a noisy demonstration by a few hundred supporters of President Alberto Fujimori, shouting for freedom for the 72 hostages inside the residence.

Meetings between the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) guerrillas and the mediation commission have usually been the first stage before face-to-face negotiations between the rebels and the government.
